egress.title: Network of commands
egress.intro: Commands that run in isolation reach the network only through a proxy that asks LocalAI about each connection. Set the limit, the preset of a new chat, the ports, the extra registries and the audit retention below; a person chooses the preset of each chat in its Tools menu, up to the limit, and allows a blocked host on a card.

egress.private: Let an administrator’s rule reach private networks
egress.privateWarning: A host that an administrator allows can then reach addresses inside your network. A preset alone never does, and the cloud metadata and server addresses stay refused.

settingsTools.intro: The chats have a few built-in tools that an add-on can replace. When the add-on is installed, running and on for a chat, the chat uses the add-on's tool instead, under the same name.
settingsTools.empty: No built-in tool can be managed on this server.
settingsTools.loadFailed: The built-in tools could not be read
settingsTools.replaceExplain: These add-ons replace {{tool}}: the one chosen serves it in every chat where it is on and running, and the built-in is hidden. Only one can be active. Until you choose, the one installed first serves.
settingsTools.choose_one: {{count}} add-on replaces {{tool}}: choose which one to use.
settingsTools.choose_other: {{count}} add-ons replace {{tool}}: choose which one to use.

descriptions.bash: Runs commands and code for the chats directly on this machine when no add-on serves bash. An add-on that runs commands in isolation replaces it.
descriptions.web_search: Searches the web for the chats without a key (DuckDuckGo, then Brave Search, then Bing), or with your SearXNG instance when one is set.
descriptions.web_fetch: Reads a public web page or file by its address for the chats. Addresses inside your network are refused unless you allow them.
descriptions.list_agents: Lets a chat list the user's saved agents and start one as a sub-agent. Each chat switches it on in its Tools menu.
descriptions.localai_client: Lets the chats run the models installed here for images, speech, sound, video, embeddings and detection, within each user's permissions.
descriptions.localai_admin: Lets the chats of administrators manage this server: models, backends, settings and the state. Each chat, or saved agent, switches it on.

bash.switch: Let chats run commands on this machine
bash.askHint: Only administrators' chats get it, and each command waits for their yes in the chat.
bash.onHint: Every user's chats run commands here without asking, also scheduled runs and sub-agents.
bash.warning: Commands run as the user LocalAI runs as, with no isolation and with this machine's network: they can read what LocalAI can read and reach the internet, your network and the LocalAI API. Every command is logged. Install an add-on that isolates commands.

settingsTools.skillsIntro: An add-on can replace a built-in skill with its own, written for its tools. When several add-ons replace one, choose the one that serves.
settingsTools.skillNotRunning: The chosen add-on is not running: the built-in skill serves.
settingsTools.toolNotRunning: The add-on that replaces this tool is not running: the built-in tool serves.
